# Labels in the app

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Limit a label to some numbers

- **What it is:** Show a label only on some numbers.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Labels > the label > Advanced
- **The agent can:** create, rename and delete labels with the label tools (Full access); the number limit is set in the app
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels.md, section "limit-a-label-to-some-numbers". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels#limit-a-label-to-some-numbers

## Label leads from ads automatically

- **What it is:** A chat from an ad gets a label with the ad's headline.
- **Plan:** Every plan. It is on by default.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Labels > Label leads from ads automatically
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels.md, section "how-labels-get-applied". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels#how-labels-get-applied
